The '''Endministrator''' is a 6★ [[Physical]] [[Guard]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] who is also the main character in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. They are an all-rounded [[Sword]] user, with a combo skill that caters to other operators and unique Originium Arts for sealing the enemy.

==Profile==
The Endministrator of [[Endfield Industries]].<br/>In the recorded history of [[Talos-II]], the Endministrator stands as a key guardian who protected civilization on this planet and saved humanity from multiple catastrophic disasters. The Endmin's heroic deeds have given rise to many stories, tales, and even rumors.<br/>However, the Endmin's identity remains elusive and only a handful of people have seen the legend in person.<br/>Other factions within the [[Civilization Band]] are well aware that Endfield has a very special trump card in their hand, but that is all they know.<br/>The Endministrator's mysterious mastery over [[Originium]] and the Protocol Network, along with the Endmin's need for periodic long-term hibernation, is one of Endfield's most important secrets.
